meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Kalewadi | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching for Kalewadi students at our Wakad branch, via Kalewadi Phata. Faculty from Kota, {{fact:batch.days}} from {{fact:batch.timings#start}}.

intro: Kalewadi students are about {{commute:kalewadi#km}} km from our Wakad branch, the closer of our two centres.

body.text: Hedgewar Road and Kaspate Vasti Road bring you to Wakad, joining it at Kalewadi Phata.

sections.heading: Kalewadi's place on the map

body.text: Kalewadi is linked to Chinchwad by the Hedgewar Bridge and to Pimpri by the Pavna bridge, while Kalewadi Phata connects it to Wakad and our branch.

body: Our head office in New Sangvi is farther from Kalewadi, so Wakad is the centre we suggest here.

body.text: Start JEE preparation with the two-year programme after Class 10, or take the one-year programme in Class 12.

questions.q: Which centre should a Kalewadi student join?
questions.a: The Wakad branch, about {{commute:kalewadi#km}} km away.

questions.q: How long is each class day?
Does my child get study material?

a.text: Yes: notes, solved examples, chapter-wise problem sets and past IIT JEE papers with solutions.
